head_commit.message:
Redesign the protocol lab as an operations console (#13)

* Redesign the protocol lab as an operations console

Replace the ruled-paper editorial page with a single console that puts the lab above the fold: scenario picker and replay controls in one toolbar, a state path that fills and recolours as the journal is stepped, the two exchange legs with tabular values, and the event journal with its derived states. Colour is now reserved for protocol state. The disclosure is one line in the header.

Add an SVG favicon, which fixes the two favicon.ico 404s logged on Pages. Add npm run build:pages for the /barter/ build and drop the stale copy of three old builds under docs/, which Pages never served (it publishes the gh-pages branch).

* Keep Run tape advancing after the second event

The playback effect did not depend on step, so its timer was armed once
and the tape stalled at step 2.

* Derive leg quantities from the journal

Journal events can now carry a leg amendment. The replay applies amendments in order and returns the derived offered and requested legs, and the value gap is computed from them. The wheat counter-offer event amends the offered leg to 387.4 t, so from step 2 the lab shows 387.4 t, $147,987 and a gap of -$13 instead of 420 t and +$12,440. Stepping back restores the listed quantity.

Amendments are part of the journal hash only when present, so the copper and cocoa marks are unchanged and pinned by a test. The wheat marks change from step 2 on. The unit price moves to its own line so the amended quantity never wraps.
